messages:
Priya Nair: @channel taking over handoff now. There was a P1 alert from PagerDuty right before my shift. PagerDuty: INC12345 - embeddings-euw1 high error rate (502).
Ethan Cole: I'm still on the bridge for 5 more mins, could Priya be primary driver? I can be comms while I finish notes.
Priya Nair: I'll drive. Ethan, can you be comms until 11:10 UTC? After that we need a secondary/backup — Samir, can you cover secondary monitoring?
Samir Patel: I can monitor but I'm in a call until 11:05 UTC. After that I can take secondary and follow runbook.
Maya Ruiz: Quick status from metrics: 502 rate spiked across west1 and euw1, affected ~8% of requests for embeddings. No error burst in hosted text-gen. Customer impact appears to be degraded batch embedding jobs, not interactive chat.
incident-bot: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-502 — steps 1-4 apply: check GPU pool health, restart workers, check model variant fallbacks.
Priya Nair: Copy runbook. First step I'm running: check dedicated pool health and recent redeploys.
Ethan Cole: I'll post updates to #incidents-status every 10m and coordinate with support for customers on queued batch jobs.
Priya Nair: Samir, if you see error rate not falling by 11:15, trigger fallback to quantized-variant as per runbook step 3. Use this command: 
```
redwoodctl fallback --model embeddings-v2 --variant q4_0
```
Samir Patel: Got it. If fallback happens, double-check tokenization parity on a test vector first.
Maya Ruiz: Adding monitoring note: enabling longer sampling window to avoid noisy flips while restart happens.
Ethan Cole: Assigning comms: @support-team to draft a short customer-facing note — 'intermittent failures affecting batch embeddings; engineers are investigating; ETA 30m' — I can shepherd.
Priya Nair: Confirming ownership: Priya driving, Ethan comms until 11:10, Samir secondary after 11:05. If Ethan needs to leave, Maya will be fallback comms.
incident-bot: Reminder: log all mitigation steps to the incident ticket INC12345.
Priya Nair: I'll update the ticket as we go. If we need to escalate to infra SRE, I'll call paging-escalate.
Ethan Cole: 11:03 — Samir monitoring now; error rate down to 4.5% and falling. I'll keep customers updated. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Thanks team — keeping bridge open, will post final on resolution or if we need escalation.
